title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00051 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: Performed pre-job meeting to use manual rig tong
00:15 - 02:00: Attempted to release tieback adapter w/ manual tongs several times. Applied left hand torque in steps. Used TDS brake to lock in torque when making new bite with manual tong. Adapter came loose at 42knm torque. Rotated string approximately 6 turns left, observed mark on pipe moved 3 inches up
02:00 - 02:45: POOH w/ torque tool, l/d same
02:45 - 03:45: P/u ITCO spear RIH same on 5,5 DP to top of the fish at 136m. Engaged spear to fish.
03:45 - 04:30: POOH w/ fish from 136m to surface
04:30 - 05:15: Set slips on 10 3/4in tieback casing stump. Released spear and r/b same. L/d tieback adapter fish
05:15 - 05:45: Cleaned and cleared rig floor
05:45 - 06:00: Performed pre-job meeting to handle guns
06:00 - 07:00: M/u gun
07:00 - 07:15: Performed pre-job meeting to RIH w/ gun
07:15 - 08:15: RU to run gun. Changed handling equipment
08:15 - 09:15: RIH w/ gun to 140m. Installed gog collar on all stands. P/u 3m pup
09:15 - 09:30: M/u TDS. Took up/down weights 73t/69t, RIH to 148,5m bottom shot
09:30 - 10:30: Closed UPR, opened choke. Applied 10 bar on IBOP. Opened IBOP to confirm line up. Filled string. Opened UPR, broke off TDS and droped 1 1/8 ball in string. M/u TDS. Closed UPR and opened choke. Fired guns with 130 l/m, 137 bar. Top shot at 145,5m, bottom shot at 148,5m continued to circulate w/ 160l/min 4,8 bar. Mud in returns
10:30 - 11:15: Increased pump rate to 1000l/min bar. Pressure droped to 2,7 bar. Observed only water in returns. Circulated 2x bottom up, MAX gas 0,1 Stoped pumps. Observed h2s readings after 2 min. Continued to circulate w/ 1000l/min 2,7 bar. MAX h2s gas in return fluid 8ppm
11:15 - 11:30: Flowchecked well over choke. Static
11:30 - 11:45: Flowchecked well over trip tank. Static
11:45 - 12:30: L/d 3m pup. POOH w/ gun from 148,5m to 14,4m
12:30 - 13:30: Broke off firing head, recovered blank, l/d BHA and single. All shots fired

Attempted to release tieback adapter w/ manual tongs several times. Applied left hand torque in steps. Used TDS brake to lock in torque when making new bite with manual tong. Adapter came loose at 42knm torque. Rotated string approximately 6 turns left, observed mark on pipe moved 3 inches up

Performed pre-job meeting to RIH w/ gun
RU to run gun. Changed handling equipment
RIH w/ gun to 140m. Installed gog collar on all stands. P/u 3m pup
M/u TDS. Took up/down weights 73t/69t, RIH to 148,5m bottom shot

Closed UPR, opened choke. Applied 10 bar on IBOP. Opened IBOP to confirm line up. Filled string. Opened UPR, broke off TDS and droped 1 1/8 ball in string. M/u TDS. Closed UPR and opened choke. Changed handling equipment
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u milling assy

P/u cutter assy broke off float sub, l/d cutter assy M/u taper mill and hanger mill changed handling equipment. P/u shock tool and m/u to taper/hanger mill. Installed float sub, installed string magnet and x-over
P/u 9x 8,25in DC from cantilever and RIH. RIH to 135m w/ 1x stand of overtorqued 5,5in DP
Carried out drop check on TDS. Serviced drilling equipment
P/u single. Recorded parameters up/down weights 86t/82t, 80 RPM, 2000l/min 11bar. Tagged at 140,44m
Mill 10 3/4in subsea CSG hanger. 1970l/min, 9bar, 80-120rpm, 5-13knm, 1-8t wob
